scope: spectral-energy subalgebra generated by E_k=||P_k q||^2
theorem: The positive strict spectrum has six real modal-energy generators. Their commutative homogeneous degree-four and degree-six spectral-energy bases have dimensions C(7,2)=21 and C(8,3)=56. A selects distinguished weighted sums but does not select the 77 general coefficients or their stabilizing signs.
